prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 公式文本 · 物理量 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "物理量" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "符号" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 3: header "公式" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 91px
  col 4: header "单位" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 77px · one-line width 274px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"A compact physics formula reference: for each quantity it gives the symbol, defining formula, unit and a short explanatory note, for lookup and quick comparison rather than continuous reading.","reading":"Readers scan row by row: quantity name → symbol → formula → unit, then drop into the note. Columns 2–4 form a compact technical core, while 说明 is secondary but contains constants and caveats that must remain legible.","groups":["Columns 2 符号, 3 公式 and 4 单位 belong together: they are the technical identity of each quantity and should stay adjacent and compact.","Column 1 物理量 is the row entry point and label.","Column 5 说明 is explanatory annotation and can absorb wrapping."],"keep_intact":["symbols such as E_k, F, E","formula tokens and operators; ideally whole formulas, at minimum unbreakable terms such as ½mv² and G·m₁m₂/r²","units J and N","scientific notation such as 6.674×10⁻¹¹","short headers 符号, 公式, 单位"],"may_wrap":["物理量 names such as 理想气体状态方程","说明 prose and notes","formulas at = or spaces if necessary, but not inside tokens"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [54, 51, 105, 51, 98] · table 360×392px · row heights [60, 83, 83, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [73, 51, 86, 51, 98] · table 360×392px · row heights [60, 83, 83, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [66, 40, 86, 40, 127] · table 360×368px · row heights [60, 83, 60, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 3/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"The technical core (符号 · 公式 · 单位) stays adjacent and compact, so a reader can scan symbol → formula → unit without eye travel; 说明 is clearly the annotation column and the overall column order matches reading order.","problems":"Three of five headers break (物理/量, 符/号, 单/位), which makes the header band look taller and ragged than the body, and it competes with the body for attention. 物理量 names like 理想气体状态方程 shatter into four short lines, so the row entry point — the thing the eye lands on first — is the least readable cell. 说明 is so narrow that 'G ≈ 6.674×10⁻¹¹' breaks after the ≈, splitting the constant from its value and destroying the note's lookup value.","cause":"Col 1 at 54px gives only 33px of text = two CJK characters per line, so 3-character header 物理量 and 8-character names cannot hold a line. Cols 2 and 4 at 51px give 30px, one pixel short of the 31px one-line header width, so 符号 and 单位 wrap. 说明 at 98px gives 77px… minus rounding, so the 77px token 6.674×10⁻¹¹ spills. Only 公式 at 105 (84px text) is generously sized, and it still can't hold 'E_k = ½mv²' (91px) on one line — width spent where it does least good."},{"design":"r0B","good":"物理量 now holds its header on one line and row names read in three lines instead of four, so the left edge is much calmer; 公式 at 86px is still wide enough that no formula token (65px 'G·m₁m₂/r²') is ever split.","problems":"符号 and 单位 still break into vertical 符/号 and 单/位 stacks, which reads as two skinny columns of noise next to the healthy 公式 column. 说明 remains the weak point: the constant still breaks after ≈ and the note cells are the tallest in every row, driving row height to 83–106px.","cause":"Cols 2 and 4 were kept at 51px, one pixel under the 52px needed for a 31px header. Give 物理量 66px (45px text) so its header holds one line and names read in three lines, keep 公式 at 86px (65px text) so no formula token is ever split, and hand the remaining 103px to 说明 (82px text) so 6.674×10⁻¹¹ and N·m²/kg² stay whole. Every column now clears its minimum; the only wrap left is 说明 prose, which is where wrapping belongs."},{"name":"r1-formula-first","widths":[66,52,90,52,99],"change":"Same clean headers as r1-balanced, but take 4px from 说明 and 4px from nothing else — widen 公式 to 90px — so the equation column has more breathing room around the '=' break and 'E_k =' / '½mv²' sit visually centred rather than cramped; 说明 at 99px still shows 78px of text, just enough to keep the 77px scientific-notation token intact on one line."},{"name":"r1-roomy","widths":[66,54,86,54,99],"change":"A different idea: instead of minimising 符号/单位, give them 2px of slack each (54px) so short symbols like E_k and single letters sit centred with air rather than wedged against the padding — the technical core reads as a tidy block. Paid for by 说明 (99px, 78px text), which still holds its longest token, while 物理量 keeps its one-line header and 公式 stays at the 86px floor that protects every formula token."}]}
